title: JSX, Components, and Props
description: Learn how JSX works, how to create components, and how to pass and use data via props to build dynamic user interfaces.

lessons.title: What is JSX?
lessons.content: JSX is a syntax extension for JavaScript that looks like HTML. It makes writing React components easier by combining HTML structure with JavaScript logic.

lessons.title: JSX Syntax and Rules
Creating a Functional Component
Component Reusability with Props
lessons.content: Props allow the same component to be reused with different data. This keeps the UI DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) and scalable.
